subject: CloudResell x Redwood — follow-up & technical intake coordination
messages:
From: Tom Wu <tom.wu@cloudresell.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@aws-partners.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T14:02:00Z
Subject: CloudResell x Redwood — follow-up & technical intake

Hi Marcus / Vanessa / Camila,

Thanks for the intro call this morning — appreciate the clear roadmap on how Redwood serves marketplace-first partners. CloudResell is excited to move toward a technical intake so we can scope the AWS Marketplace listing, entitlement mapping, and buyer experience.

Quick recap from our side:
- Use case: multi-tenant SaaS customers want to spin up dedicated inference via Marketplace billing; key questions around metering and billing dimensions.
- Primary stakeholders: CloudResell product (me), AWS partner manager (Priya), and the CloudResell engineering lead (I'll loop in if needed).

Next step request: Can we schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive / integration intake with an engineering-focused agenda (service endpoints, auth/KMS, billing hooks, and acceptance test plan)? Prefer early next week. Here are windows that work for our team (all PT):
- Tue June 1: 9:00–11:00 or 14:00–16:00 PT
- Wed June 2: 10:00–12:00 PT

Attachments: I attached a reseller intake form to capture basic entitlement and buyer flow info (redwood-cloud-reseller-intake-form.pdf).

Also- Priya: are there AWS Marketplace checklist items you recommend we include in the agenda?

Thanks,
Tom

--
Tom Wu
Partnerships, CloudResell Inc.
{"attachment":"redwood-cloud-reseller-intake-form.pdf"}

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Wu <tom.wu@cloudresell.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@aws-partners.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T15:10:00Z
Subject: Re: CloudResell x Redwood — follow-up & technical intake

Tom — thanks for the clear recap and the intake form. Good to meet earlier — we can walk through the deep-dive agenda and capture what’s needed for Marketplace listing.

I can make the following windows work (PT):
- Tue June 1: 9:30–10:30 or 14:30–15:30 PT
- Wed June 2: 10:00–11:00 PT (preferred)

Proposed agenda (60 min):
1) Quick intro and roles (5 min)
2) Integration surface: endpoint patterns, auth/KMS, data flow (20 min)
3) Metering & billing dimensions for Marketplace & entitlement sync (15 min)
4) Acceptance tests / QA and minimal viable listing items (10 min)
5) Next steps and owners (10 min)

I'm attaching a short Redwood platform overview deck to share with the team ahead of the session (redwood-platform-overview-deck-v1.pdf). Vanessa — can you take the lead on the acceptance test section? Camila — can you cover model or runtime constraints we should call out?

Priya — appreciate any Marketplace-specific items you want on the agenda (metering, procurement flow, or AWS docs to review ahead).

If Wed June 2 10:00 PT works for everyone, I can send a calendar invite.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Head of BD, Redwood Inference
{"attachment":"redwood-platform-overview-deck-v1.pdf"}

Marcus / Tom — I can take point on acceptance tests. Wed June 2 at 10:00 PT works for me.

Suggested additions to the agenda:
- Short demo of the deployment lifecycle (what we expect from partner side to spin up a customer)
- Security/compliance checklist (KMS, VPC peering, logging)
- Minimal E2E test that qualifies a listing for GA

I added quick notes inline in the attached intake PDF.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=cloudresell-deepdive-20270602
